pubHome.title: Custom software that makes your SME <1>more competitive</1>
pubHome.intro: At AJR Data we solve concrete weaknesses in your business with custom development — adding chatbots, AI agents and modern features instead of generic solutions.

pubHome.pricingIntro: Starting reference prices. Each proposal is adjusted to the project scope and complexity.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: A few answers to help you know what to expect before getting started.

scope.question: How does a project with AJR Data start?
scope.answer: We begin by discussing your business problem, goals, and priorities. With that context, we can assess the scope and propose next steps.

custom.question: Do you build custom solutions?
custom.answer: Yes. We aim to understand how each business works so we can design a solution around its processes without adding unnecessary complexity.

pricing.question: Are the listed prices final?
pricing.answer: No. They are starting reference prices. The final proposal depends on the project scope, integrations, and complexity.

communication.question: How can I follow the progress of my request?
communication.answer: With an account, you can review your requests and use the support channel available on the platform to contact the team.

hosting.question: Can you help with domain and hosting?
hosting.answer: We can discuss your project’s infrastructure needs and determine which option best fits your situation.

process.title: A clear process, from start to finish
process.intro: Every project starts with understanding the problem and ends with a solution prepared for real-world use.

listen.title: We listen

jobForm.heroIntro: We are a small team that solves real SME problems with custom software: from management systems to AI assistants that give hours of work back to a business. We care more about understanding the problem well than about using the latest trend, and we like doing it in good company.
jobForm.heroOutro: If you enjoy building useful things, asking “what for?” and growing with people who have your back when something gets stuck, tell us who you are. Every application is read by a member of the team.
